Good questions.
Clear answers.

What is real in this preview?
The artwork, discoveries, story and recorded narration come from TrustinJr. The browser interface and Parent Dock are illustrative adaptations. There is no live AI conversation, microphone capture or real child account. Settings and sample activity clear on reload.
What can I guide as a parent?
We’re building for family topic preferences, listening settings and shared exploration. In this preview, “With a grown-up” replaces the Moon answer with an invitation to ask you. This specific control is illustrative. Essential child-safety safeguards remain separate from family choices. See what exists in the native beta.
What about AI mistakes and privacy?
AI can be inaccurate, and safeguards can miss things. Adult judgment, relationships, play and human teaching remain essential. This demo creates no child profile; hosting still processes ordinary requests. Native app data practices require separate verified disclosures before release. Read the website privacy notice.
Can I download TrustinJr today?
It is in development and testing. A public App Store release, launch date and pricing have not been announced. The beta uses a normally paired Apple Watch and iPhone; Family Setup onboarding remains unresolved. Check availability before buying a device.
